aalborg-denmark.description: North Jutland's lively harbour city, with a waterfront cultural quarter, a Viking burial ground and Denmark's famously cheerful nightlife.

aarhus-denmark.description: Denmark's second city, a student-filled port with the rainbow-crowned ARoS art museum, the Old Town open-air museum and Jutland beaches nearby.
activities: ARoS Aarhus Art Museum rainbow panorama

aberdeen-united-kingdom.description: Scotland's granite city on the North Sea, with a long sandy beach, a working harbour and the gateway to Royal Deeside castles and whisky country.

abu-dhabi-united-arab-emirates.description: The UAE capital pairs the vast white-marble Sheikh Zayed Mosque and the Louvre Abu Dhabi with Saadiyat Island beaches and Yas Island theme parks.

abuja-nigeria.description: Nigeria's planned capital, set among granite hills, with Zuma Rock, the grand National Mosque and a calmer, greener pace than Lagos.

accra-ghana.description: Ghana's lively Atlantic capital, with Jamestown's colonial lighthouse, buzzing Makola market, highlife music and beaches along the Gulf of Guinea.

adana-mersin-turkey.description: A pair of Turkish Mediterranean cities where kebab culture, Roman bridges and Silifke's coast and Cilician castles reward the curious.
activities: Tarsus: St Paul's Well and Cleopatra's Gate

addis-ababa-ethiopia.description: Ethiopia's high-altitude capital, with the National Museum's Lucy fossil, Merkato market, Orthodox churches and the home of coffee ceremonies.
activities: National Museum of Ethiopia and Lucy
Injera and tibs at a local restaurant

agadir-morocco.description: A modern Atlantic resort rebuilt after the 1960 earthquake, with a broad sandy bay, year-round sun and the Atlas foothills and Souss valley close by.

ahmedabad-india.description: Gujarat's old walled city of carved wooden havelis, Gandhi's Sabarmati Ashram, intricate stepwells and a famously good vegetarian thali scene.

ajaccio-france.description: Napoleon's birthplace on Corsica's west coast, with a pastel harbour, the Maison Bonaparte and sandy bays along the Sanguinaires peninsula.

akureyri-iceland.description: Iceland's northern capital at the head of a long fjord, base for whale watching, Goðafoss waterfall, Lake Mývatn and winter Northern Lights.

alesund-norway.description: A fjord-coast town rebuilt in Art Nouveau after the 1904 fire, set among islands and gateway to the Geirangerfjord and Atlantic Road.

alghero-italy.description: A walled Catalan-flavoured port on Sardinia's northwest coast, with coral-fishing heritage, Neptune's Grotto sea caves and beaches such as Le Bombarde.
activities: Neptune's Grotto boat or Escala del Cabirol

algiers-algeria.description: A white Mediterranean capital stacked above its bay, with the Casbah's winding lanes, Ottoman palaces and the Notre-Dame d'Afrique basilica.
activities: Couscous and chorba at a local restaurant

alicante-spain.description: A Costa Blanca city with a hilltop castle, a palm-lined seafront promenade and sandy beaches, plus a lively tapas and old-town scene.

almaty-kazakhstan.description: Kazakhstan's largest city beneath the snowy Trans-Ili Alatau, mixing Soviet-era parks and bazaars with mountain skiing, alpine lakes and a thriving café scene.
activities: Kok Tobe hill and cable car
Medeu skating rink and Shymbulak ski resort

almeria-spain.description: A sunny Andalusian port city beneath a vast Moorish fortress, gateway to the wild, desert-like beaches of Cabo de Gata.
activities: Tapas with a free plate in the old town

amman-jordan.description: Jordan's hilly capital, with a Roman theatre, hilltop Citadel, lively souks and a gateway to Petra, the Dead Sea and Wadi Rum.

amritsar-india.description: The Sikh holy city of Punjab, centred on the gold-roofed Golden Temple, with fiery Punjabi food and a nightly border ceremony at Wagah.
activities: Golden Temple and its free langar kitchen

ancona-italy.description: A working Adriatic port in Le Marche, with a Greek-founded old town and cathedral on a hill, and the Conero Riviera's white cliffs and coves close by.
activities: Conero Riviera beaches at Portonovo and Sirolo

ankara-turkey.description: Turkey's modern capital, home to the mausoleum of Atatürk, the superb Museum of Anatolian Civilizations and a hilltop citadel quarter of Ottoman houses.
activities: Temple of Augustus and Roman Baths

antalya-turkey.description: A Turkish Riviera resort city pairing a Roman-era old town and harbour with long beaches backed by the Taurus Mountains.

antigua-antigua-and-barbuda.description: A Caribbean island said to have a beach for every day of the year, plus Nelson's Dockyard, sailing regattas and rainforest hikes.

ashgabat-turkmenistan.description: Turkmenistan's white-marble capital, a surreal showcase of gilded monuments and fountains, set beside the Karakum Desert and the burning Darvaza gas crater.

asturias-spain.description: Spain's green northern coast, with Picos de Europa peaks, cider houses, rugged beaches and the old stone towns of Oviedo and Gijón.
activities: Covadonga Lakes and Picos de Europa

athens-greece.description: Greece's capital, where the Acropolis rises above a busy mix of ancient ruins, neighbourhood tavernas, street art and rooftop bars.

atlanta-united-states.description: The Southern hub of civil-rights history and Coca-Cola, with Martin Luther King Jr.'s birthplace, leafy Piedmont Park, the BeltLine and soul-food cooking.
activities: Martin Luther King Jr. National Historical Park
Atlanta BeltLine and Ponce City Market
Piedmont Park and Atlanta Botanical Garden

austin-united-states.description: Texas's capital of live music and barbecue, with a lakeside trail, spring-fed swimming holes and a nightly bat flight from Congress Avenue Bridge.
activities: Sixth Street and Rainey Street live music

bahrain-bahrain.description: A compact island kingdom in the Gulf, pairing the Portuguese-era Bahrain Fort and Manama's souq with pearl-diving heritage, Formula 1 and superb Arabic food.
activities: Manama Souq and Bab Al Bahrain
Tree of Life in the desert

baku-azerbaijan.description: Azerbaijan's Caspian capital, where a walled medieval Old City sits beside the flame-shaped towers, wide seafront boulevards and mud volcanoes of a petroleum-funded boomtown.
activities: Gobustan rock art and mud volcanoes
Plov and qutab in a local restaurant

baltimore-united-states.description: A working harbour city with a revitalised waterfront, the star-fort of Fort McHenry, free-entry art museums and Chesapeake blue crab on every menu.
activities: Fells Point pubs and cobbled streets

bandar-seri-begawan-brunei.description: The sultanate's quiet capital, with a gold-domed mosque, a centuries-old stilt-house water village and rainforest day trips into Temburong.
activities: Kampong Ayer water village boat tour
Ulu Temburong National Park canopy walk

banjul-the-gambia.description: The Gambia's small riverside capital, a base for Atlantic beaches, mangrove birdwatching and boat trips to the slave-trade history of Kunta Kinteh Island.

barbados-barbados.description: Easternmost Caribbean island of coral-sand beaches, colonial Bridgetown, rum distilleries and flying-fish suppers, with calm west-coast waters and surf on the Atlantic side.

bari-italy.description: Puglia's port city, with a labyrinthine old town where women still roll orecchiette by hand, the pilgrimage Basilica of San Nicola and a lively seafront.
activities: Polignano a Mare cliffs and beaches

basel-mulhouse-france.description: A Rhine-side Swiss art capital with a medieval Münster, world-class museums and Carnival, on the border with France and Germany.
activities: Vitra Design Museum in Weil am Rhein

bastia-france.description: Corsica's old port town, with a pastel Vieux-Port, a hilltop citadel and the winding Cap Corse coast road leading to quiet fishing villages.

beijing-people-s-republic-of-china.description: China's capital, where the Forbidden City, Temple of Heaven and hutong alleys sit beside futuristic skyscrapers, with the Great Wall within easy reach.
activities: Great Wall at Mutianyu or Jinshanling

beirut-lebanon.description: Lebanon's resilient seafront capital, with Ottoman-era mansions, a thriving mezze and nightlife scene, and the Roman ruins of Byblos within day-trip range.

belfast-united-kingdom.description: Northern Ireland's capital, where Titanic heritage, Victorian pubs and murals sit a short drive from the Causeway Coast.

belgrade-serbia.description: Serbia's energetic capital at the meeting of the Sava and Danube, with Kalemegdan Fortress, bohemian Skadarlija, floating river clubs and fierce nightlife.

bengaluru-india.description: India's garden-and-tech city on the Deccan plateau, with a mild climate, craft-beer taverns, Tipu Sultan's palace and a lively dosa-café culture.

bergamo-italy.description: A hilltop medieval Città Alta ringed by Venetian walls, above a calm lower town and within easy reach of Lake Como and Milan.
activities: Piazza Vecchia and Basilica di Santa Maria Maggiore
Polenta e osei and casoncelli alla bergamasca
Day trip to Lake Iseo or Milan

bergen-norway.description: A colourful Hanseatic harbour town ringed by seven mountains, and the gateway to the Norwegian fjords.

bergerac-france.description: A Dordogne river town of half-timbered lanes and wine cellars, gateway to medieval villages, cave art, chateaux and Bergerac vineyards.
activities: Truffle and foie gras market stalls

berlin-germany.description: Germany's sprawling capital, layering Cold War history, world-class museums, street art and all-night clubs across its many districts.

bermuda-united-kingdom.description: A pastel-painted Atlantic island with pink-sand beaches, turquoise coves and British-colonial towns, a long way from the Caribbean crowds.

beziers-france.description: A Languedoc town above the Orb river with a hilltop cathedral, Canal du Midi locks and sandy beaches at nearby Valras-Plage.

biarritz-france.description: A Basque-coast resort of Belle Époque villas and Atlantic surf breaks, with a lively market and Spanish tapas towns a short drive away.

bilbao-spain.description: A Basque city reborn around Frank Gehry's Guggenheim, with a lively pintxos scene, riverside walks and green hills meeting the Bay of Biscay.

billund-denmark.description: A small Jutland town best known as the birthplace of Lego, with the original LEGOLAND, Lego House and Danish countryside nearby.
activities: LEGO Ideas and Lego Brand Store
Day trip to Ribe, Denmark's oldest town

boa-vista-cape-verde.description: Cape Verde's flattest island, edged by long white beaches and Saharan dunes, with strong winds for kitesurfing and nesting turtles in summer.

bodrum-turkey.description: A lively Aegean resort town centred on a crusader castle, with white-washed bays, yacht-filled marinas and warm clear water.
activities: Bodrum Castle and Museum of Underwater Archaeology
Gulet boat trip along the coast

bogota-colombia.description: Colombia's high-altitude capital, with a colonial La Candelaria quarter, the Gold Museum, cable-car views and a fast-growing food scene.
activities: La Candelaria and Plaza de Bolívar

bologna-italy.description: Emilia-Romagna's medieval university city of red-brick porticoes and leaning towers, famed across Italy for tortellini, ragù and its food markets.
activities: Piazza Maggiore and Basilica di San Petronio
Tagliatelle al ragù and tortellini in brodo
Day trip to Modena balsamic vinegar producers

bolzano-italy.description: South Tyrol's Alpine-Italian capital, ringed by Dolomite peaks, home to Ötzi the Iceman and a cable car to the Renon plateau.
activities: Ötzi the Iceman at the South Tyrol Museum of Archaeology
Renon cable car and earth pyramids
Piazza Walther and the Christmas market
Speck, canederli and South Tyrolean wine

bordeaux-france.description: France's wine capital on the Garonne, with elegant 18th-century streets, the mirror-like Miroir d'Eau and world-famous châteaux nearby.
activities: Place de la Bourse and Miroir d'Eau

boston-united-states.description: New England's revolutionary-era capital, where the Freedom Trail, Harvard's red-brick Cambridge, Fenway Park and fresh lobster rolls sit within easy reach.
activities: Quincy Market chowder and lobster rolls

brasov-romania.description: A Transylvanian medieval town beneath Mount Tâmpa, with a Gothic Black Church, a colourful main square and Dracula's Bran Castle close by.

bratislava-slovakia.description: Slovakia's compact Danube capital, with a pastel Old Town, a hilltop castle, cheap beer and vineyards on the edge of the Little Carpathians.
activities: Bryndzové halušky at a traditional pub
Day trip to Vienna by train

bremen-germany.description: A Hanseatic city on the Weser, famous for its Roland statue, the Town Musicians fairy tale and the narrow Schnoor quarter.
activities: Marktplatz with the Town Hall and Roland statue

brest-france.description: Brittany's naval port at the tip of Finistère, with a castle-fortress, a vast oceanarium and a gateway to wild Atlantic coastline.
activities: Château de Brest and Musée de la Marine

brindisi-italy.description: A Puglian port city on the Adriatic with Roman monuments and a lively harbour, and a base for whitewashed hill towns and Salento beaches.
activities: Roman Columns marking the end of the Appian Way
Day trip to Ostuni's white old town

brive-france.description: Brive-la-Gaillarde is a market town on the edge of the Dordogne, known for its food halles, walnuts and nearby caves and villages.

brno-czech-republic.description: Moravia's laid-back university city, with a hilltop Špilberk castle, a Functionalist villa and a lively wine-and-craft-beer scene.
activities: Cathedral of St Peter and Paul

brussels-belgium.description: Belgium's grand-place capital, known for Art Nouveau townhouses, comic-strip murals, and a serious devotion to chocolate, waffles, frites and beer.
activities: Day trip to Bruges or Ghent by train

bucharest-romania.description: Romania's capital of grand boulevards and communist-era monumentality, with a revived old town, café culture and a lively nightlife.

budapest-hungary.description: Hungary's capital straddles the Danube, mixing thermal bathhouses, grand Habsburg architecture and lively ruin bars at modest prices.
activities: Ruin bar crawl in the Jewish Quarter
Goulash and lángos at the Great Market Hall

burgas-bulgaria.description: A Black Sea port city with a green seafront garden and sandy beaches, and the gateway to Sunny Beach and the old town of Nessebar.
activities: Burgas Lake and Atanasovsko Lake birdwatching
Grilled Black Sea fish and shopska salad

bydgoszcz-poland.description: A canal-threaded Polish city on the Brda river, with a restored granary waterfront, Art Nouveau streets and a thriving music scene.

cagliari-italy.description: Sardinia's hilltop capital, with a Pisan-era citadel, the Poetto beach on its doorstep and Sardinian seafood served in a fishing-quarter setting.
activities: Castello district and Bastione di Saint Remy

calgary-canada.description: Alberta's Rocky Mountain gateway city, home to the Calgary Stampede and a short drive from Banff, Lake Louise and Canmore.
activities: Calgary Tower and Prince's Island Park
Drumheller and the Royal Tyrrell Museum

carcassonne-france.description: A fairy-tale walled medieval citadel in Languedoc, with 52 towers, the Canal du Midi and nearby Cathar castles and wine country.

casablanca-morocco.description: Morocco's sprawling Atlantic metropolis, home to the vast Hassan II Mosque, Art Deco boulevards and a seafront lined with fish restaurants.
activities: Art Deco architecture in the city centre

castellon-spain.description: The quieter Costa del Azahar, with long sandy beaches at Benicàssim, the walled seaside town of Peñíscola and the Desert de les Palmes.
activities: Hiking in the Desert de les Palmes

catania-italy.description: A Sicilian baroque city built from black lava stone beneath Mount Etna, with a boisterous fish market and a base for Etna and Taormina.
activities: Piazza del Duomo and the Elephant Fountain

chambery-france.description: The old capital of Savoy, with arcaded streets and a castle of the Dukes, set between three Alpine regional parks and the ski resorts of the Alps.
activities: Skiing at Les Arcs or La Plagne
Parc naturel régional du Massif des Bauges

changsha-people-s-republic-of-china.description: Hunan's riverside capital, famed for fiery Xiang cuisine, buzzing night markets, Orange Isle on the Xiang River and the Hunan Museum's Han dynasty treasures.
activities: Orange Isle and Mao Zedong statue
Hunan Museum and Mawangdui silk burial
Taiping Street and Huangxing Road night food
Stinky tofu and Xiang-style spicy dishes

chania-greece.description: A Venetian harbour town in western Crete, with Ottoman lanes, lively tavernas and gorges and pink-sand beaches within reach.

charlotte-united-states.description: North Carolina's fast-growing banking hub, with NASCAR heritage, a lively NoDa arts district, craft breweries and the Blue Ridge Mountains a short drive away.
activities: Day trip to the Blue Ridge Mountains

chengdu-people-s-republic-of-china.description: Sichuan's relaxed capital, home to giant pandas, fiery hotpot, teahouse culture and the gateway to Leshan's colossal Buddha.
activities: Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding

chennai-india.description: Tamil Nadu's coastal capital, where Dravidian temples, Marina Beach, Fort St George and filter coffee with crisp dosas anchor a deeply South Indian city.
activities: Day trip to Mahabalipuram shore temples

chicago-united-states.description: The Midwest's lakefront skyscraper city, with architecture river cruises, the Art Institute, deep-dish pizza, blues clubs and summer festivals in Millennium Park.

chisinau-moldova.description: Moldova's leafy, Soviet-planned capital, a gateway to the country's cave-cellar wineries including Cricova and Mileștii Mici, among the world's largest.
activities: Central Market and Stefan cel Mare park
Day trip to Tiraspol in Transnistria

chongqing-people-s-republic-of-china.description: A mountain megacity at the meeting of two rivers, with stacked cliffside districts, blazing hotpot, night views from Hongya Cave and Yangtze cruises.
activities: Liziba monorail through an apartment block
Yangtze River cruise to the Three Gorges

cincinnati-united-states.description: An Ohio River city of Over-the-Rhine's restored Italianate streets, Cincinnati chili, craft breweries, historic Findlay Market and America's oldest professional baseball team.
activities: Cincinnati chili at Skyline or Gold Star

cluj-napoca-romania.description: Transylvania's student-filled cultural capital, with a Gothic St Michael's Church, lively cafes, strong music festivals and easy access to the Apuseni mountains.
activities: St Michael's Church and Unirii Square

cologne-bonn-germany.description: Germany's Rhine-side cathedral city, with a towering Gothic Dom, a lively old-town brewery scene and some of the country's best museums.
activities: Cologne Cathedral and its south tower climb

constanta-romania.description: Romania's oldest city and largest Black Sea port, mixing Roman ruins and a grand casino with the beach resorts of nearby Mamaia.
activities: Ovidiu Square statue and Archaeological Museum
Day trip to the Danube Delta

copenhagen-denmark.description: Denmark's waterfront capital of colourful Nyhavn houses, canal harbour baths, design shops and a world-leading food scene, best explored by bike.
activities: Day trip to Kronborg Castle in Helsingør

corfu-greece.description: A green Ionian island of Venetian fortresses, olive groves and sheltered coves, with an elegant UNESCO-listed old town.

cork-ireland.description: Ireland's second city, a compact riverside hub of food markets and pubs, and the base for Blarney Castle and the Wild Atlantic Way.

craiova-romania.description: Oltenia's elegant university city, home to the sprawling Nicolae Romanescu Park, a Belle Époque Art Museum and lively café-lined old streets.
activities: Nicolae Romanescu Park and its Parcul Mare lake
Craiova Art Museum in the Jean Mihail Palace
Old Town café terraces on Calea Unirii
Constantin Brâncuși sculpture trail at Târgu Jiu
Wine tasting in nearby Segarcea vineyards

dakar-senegal.description: West Africa's vibrant Atlantic capital, with a bustling Sandaga market, the Gorée Island slave-trade memorial and a celebrated music and surf scene.
activities: Gorée Island ferry and House of Slaves

dalaman-turkey.description: The gateway to Turkey's Turkish Riviera, near Ölüdeniz's lagoon, Dalyan's river tombs and pine-backed coves along the Turquoise Coast.
activities: Dalyan river trip to the Lycian rock tombs

dallas-fort-worth-united-states.description: A sprawling Texas metroplex pairing Dallas's skyline and JFK history with Fort Worth's Stockyards cowboy culture and top-tier museums.
activities: Sixth Floor Museum at Dealey Plaza

dar-es-salaam-tanzania.description: Tanzania's sultry Indian Ocean port, a base for Zanzibar ferries and safaris, with Swahili markets, fresh seafood and palm-fringed island beaches nearby.
activities: National Museum and House of Culture
Day safari in Selous (Nyerere) National Park

debrecen-hungary.description: Hungary's second city on the Great Plain, with a grand Reformed Great Church, Hortobágy puszta horse shows and the Aquaticum thermal spa.
activities: Nagyerdő Park and Aquaticum thermal spa
Debreceni sausage and Gundel-style Hungarian cooking

delhi-india.description: India's sprawling capital, where Mughal forts, Old Delhi spice bazaars and Lutyens' grand boulevards sit beside serious street food.
activities: Lodhi Garden and Hauz Khas Village
Day trip to the Taj Mahal in Agra

denver-united-states.description: The Mile High City sits where the Great Plains meet the Rockies, with craft breweries, a lively food scene and mountains within an hour.
activities: Day trip to Rocky Mountain National Park

derry-united-kingdom.description: Northern Ireland's walled city on the River Foyle, known for its intact 17th-century ramparts, Bogside murals and a thriving music and arts scene.
activities: Bogside murals and Free Derry Corner
Day trip to Mussenden Temple and the Causeway Coast

detroit-united-states.description: The Motor City pairs Motown history and Art Deco towers with the Detroit Institute of Arts, a revived riverfront and a strong food and music scene.
activities: The Henry Ford Museum in Dearborn

dhaka-bangladesh.description: Bangladesh's teeming capital, where rickshaw-clogged lanes lead to Mughal forts, Old Dhaka's riverfront and some of South Asia's best street food.

djerba-tunisia.description: A flat, sunny Tunisian island of whitewashed villages, sandy beaches, a historic synagogue and the medina market of Houmt Souk.
activities: Djerba Explore and Lella Hadria Museum

doha-qatar.description: Qatar's gleaming capital, where the Museum of Islamic Art and Souq Waqif sit beside futuristic towers and desert dunes.

dortmund-germany.description: A Ruhr city best known for football at Signal Iduna Park, with a rebuilt old town, a vibrant brewing heritage and industrial landmarks nearby.
activities: Borussia Dortmund match at Signal Iduna Park

dublin-ireland.description: Ireland's compact capital pairs Georgian squares, literary pubs and the Guinness Storehouse with easy coastal escapes along Dublin Bay.
activities: Book of Kells at Trinity College

dundee-united-kingdom.description: Scotland's waterfront city on the Firth of Tay, home to the V&A Dundee, Discovery Point and RRS Discovery, and a lively arts and gaming scene.
activities: Day trip to Glamis Castle or St Andrews

dusseldorf-germany.description: A fashionable Rhine city known for the Königsallee, the Altstadt's brewhouses and its altbier, and a striking modern harbour.

eindhoven-netherlands.description: The Netherlands' design and technology capital, with the Van Abbemuseum, the converted Strijp-S factory district and easy cycling around its canals and parks.
activities: Day trip to Den Bosch for a Bossche bol

enfidha-tunisia.description: A modern resort coast of white sand beaches and all-inclusive hotels, close to Hammamet, Sousse's medina and the Roman amphitheatre at El Djem.

entebbe-uganda.description: A Lake Victoria shore town and Uganda's gateway, with a botanical garden, chimpanzee sanctuary island and easy routes to gorilla country.

erbil-iraq.description: Capital of Iraqi Kurdistan, centred on a citadel inhabited for thousands of years, with lively bazaars, tea houses and mountain day trips.
activities: Shanidar and Gali Ali Beg waterfall day trip
Kurdish kebab and dolma at a local restaurant

essaouira-morocco.description: A whitewashed Atlantic port with a walled medina, fortified sea ramparts, breezy beaches and some of Morocco's best grilled fish.

faro-portugal.description: The gateway to Portugal's Algarve, with a walled old town, lagoon islands and golden beaches along the surrounding coast.

fez-morocco.description: Morocco's medieval capital, where the vast Fes el-Bali medina, working tanneries and ancient madrasas make for a maze of living history.

figari-france.description: The gateway to southern Corsica, with turquoise Bonifacio cliffs, Porto-Vecchio's white-sand coves and granite-ringed beaches like Rondinara and Palombaggia.
activities: Bonifacio citadel and cliff-top old town
Boat trip to the Lavezzi Islands

florence-italy.description: The cradle of the Renaissance, packing Michelangelo's David, the Duomo and the Uffizi into a walkable city on the Arno.

forli-italy.description: A Romagna city with a striking Fascist-era centre and a gentle base for Ravenna's mosaics, Rimini's beaches and Emilian food.

frankfurt-germany.description: Germany's financial hub, a skyscraper-lined city on the River Main with a rebuilt old town, museum riverfront and traditional apple-wine taverns.
activities: Apple wine in a Sachsenhausen tavern

freetown-sierra-leone.description: A hilly Atlantic capital with palm-fringed beaches on the peninsula, a historic cotton tree and a chimpanzee sanctuary close to the city.
activities: Bunce Island slave fort boat trip
Freshly grilled fish on the beach

friedrichshafen-germany.description: A lakeside town on Lake Constance, home of the Zeppelin, with Alpine views, cycling paths and ferries to Switzerland and Austria.
activities: Day trip to Mainau flower island

fuerteventura-spain.description: A Canary island of wide white-sand beaches, steady Atlantic winds and volcanic desert landscapes, popular for windsurfing and year-round sun.

funchal-portugal.description: Madeira's hillside capital, climbing from a sunny harbour to flower-filled gardens, with levada walks, cable cars and fortified wine on the doorstep.
activities: Monte cable car and toboggan ride
Poncha and espetada in Câmara de Lobos

gaziantep-turkey.description: Turkey's gastronomic capital in the south-east, famed for pistachio baklava, a mosaic museum of Roman Zeugma and a citadel-crowned old quarter.

gdansk-poland.description: A Baltic port city of rebuilt merchant façades along the Motława river, amber workshops, shipyard history and the Solidarity story, near Sopot's beaches.

geneva-switzerland.description: A lakeside city of diplomacy and watchmaking, ringed by the Alps and Jura, with its famous jet d'eau.
activities: Old Town and St Peter's Cathedral
Mont Blanc day trip from Chamonix

genoa-italy.description: A faded-grand port city of marble palaces and narrow caruggi alleys, with Europe's largest medieval centre, a big aquarium and focaccia and pesto at source.
activities: Palazzi dei Rolli on Via Garibaldi
Focaccia and pesto in the old town

georgetown-guyana.description: Guyana's colonial-era capital of wooden Caribbean architecture, canals and markets, and the gateway to Kaieteur Falls and Amazonian rainforest.

gibraltar-united-kingdom.description: A tiny British territory under a towering limestone Rock, with wild Barbary macaques, Mediterranean views and Spain a short walk away.
activities: Barbary macaques at the Upper Rock

girona-spain.description: A compact Catalan city of medieval walls, a colourful Onyar riverfront and a preserved Jewish quarter, close to Costa Brava coves and Dalí's Figueres.
activities: Walk the Passeig de la Muralla city walls
Day trip to the Dalí Theatre-Museum in Figueres
Costa Brava coves at Tossa de Mar

giza-egypt.description: Home to the Great Pyramids and the Sphinx on Cairo's western edge, with the Grand Egyptian Museum close to the plateau.

glasgow-united-kingdom.description: Scotland's largest city is a Victorian-built hub of free museums, a thriving live music scene and Art Nouveau design, near Loch Lomond.
activities: Mackintosh trail at the Willow Tearooms

goa-india.description: India's beach state of palm-fringed sands, Portuguese-era churches, spice plantations, seafood shacks and a lively party scene.
activities: Basilica of Bom Jesus in Old Goa

gothenburg-sweden.description: Sweden's relaxed west-coast second city of canals, a lively fish market, leafy Haga cafés and an archipelago of car-free islands just offshore.
activities: Ferry to the Southern Archipelago islands

gran-canaria-spain.description: A Canary island of contrasts, with the Maspalomas dunes, a lively old quarter in Las Palmas and mountain villages inland.
activities: Vegueta old town in Las Palmas

granada-spain.description: An Andalusian city beneath the Sierra Nevada, crowned by the Alhambra palace and full of Moorish lanes and free tapas.
activities: Day trip to the Sierra Nevada

grand-cayman-united-kingdom.description: The largest Cayman Island, known for powder-white Seven Mile Beach, world-class diving and calm turquoise water, with a relaxed British Caribbean feel.

rennes-france.description: Brittany's capital, a student city of half-timbered medieval streets, Saturday's Marché des Lices and a short hop to Mont-Saint-Michel.

reus-spain.description: A Catalan market town of Modernista façades and Gaudí's birthplace, minutes from the sandy resorts of the Costa Dorada and Salou.

rhodes-greece.description: A Dodecanese island where a walled medieval Old Town, Lindos's hilltop acropolis and long Aegean beaches share one sunny coastline.

riga-latvia.description: Latvia's Baltic capital, with Europe's finest Art Nouveau architecture, a medieval old town, a vast Central Market and lively craft-beer bars.
activities: Art Nouveau district on Alberta iela
Central Market in the Zeppelin hangars
Black balsam and smoked fish tasting

rijeka-croatia.description: Croatia's gritty Adriatic port and former European Capital of Culture, with Habsburg architecture, a hilltop castle and easy access to Opatija and Istria.
activities: Korzo promenade and City Clock Tower

rimini-italy.description: Adriatic Riviera resort with a wide sandy beach, a Roman arch and bridge in the old town, and Italy's liveliest summer nightlife.
activities: Arch of Augustus and Tiberius Bridge

riyadh-saudi-arabia.description: Saudi Arabia's fast-changing capital, mixing the mud-brick heritage of Diriyah with glass towers, entertainment districts and desert escarpments on its doorstep.
activities: Masmak Fortress and Al Zal Souq

rotterdam-the-hague-netherlands.description: The Netherlands' bold, rebuilt port city of daring modern architecture, waterfront markets and street art, with The Hague's museums close by.
activities: Water taxi around the Erasmus Bridge and Maas harbour

rovaniemi-finland.description: The Arctic Circle capital of Finnish Lapland, with Northern Lights, husky sleds, reindeer farms and Santa Claus Village.
activities: Midnight sun on the Ounasvaara fell

rzeszow-poland.description: A compact south-eastern Polish city with a lively market square, a quirky underground tourist route and fairy-tale palaces nearby in the Podkarpacie foothills.
activities: Rzeszów Market Square and Town Hall

sal-cape-verde.description: A flat, sun-baked Atlantic island of long white beaches and steady trade winds, with kitesurfing, salt-crater floating and Cape Verdean live music.
activities: Floating in the Pedra de Lume salt crater
Lemon shark watching at Shark Bay
Morna and funaná music in Santa Maria

salen-trysil-sweden.description: A cross-border Scandinavian ski region in the Swedish mountains, with family-friendly slopes, cross-country trails, husky sledding and the start line of the Vasaloppet.
activities: Alpine skiing in Tandådalen and Hundfjället
Cross-country skiing on the Vasaloppet trail
Skiing across the border at Trysil in Norway

salerno-italy.description: A lively port city at the gateway to the Amalfi Coast, with a medieval old town, a palm-lined seafront and ferries to Positano and Amalfi.

salzburg-austria.description: Mozart's birthplace, a baroque Alpine city beneath a hilltop fortress, with lakes and mountains within easy reach of its old town.

samos-greece.description: A green, hilly Aegean island where Pythagoras was born, with ancient Heraion ruins, sweet muscat wine, mountain villages and quiet pebble coves.
activities: Muscat wine tasting at Samos cooperatives
Hike Mount Kerkis and Potami waterfalls

santiago-de-compostela-spain.description: The granite end-point of the Camino de Santiago in Galicia, centred on a Romanesque cathedral and rain-polished medieval streets.
activities: Pulpo a la gallega and Padrón peppers
Walk the final stage of the Camino Francés

sarajevo-bosnia-and-herzegovina.description: Bosnia's mountain-ringed capital, where Ottoman bazaars, Austro-Hungarian boulevards and powerful wartime history sit within a few walkable streets.
activities: Day trip to Mostar and Kravice waterfalls

shanghai-people-s-republic-of-china.description: China's glittering financial hub, where the colonial Bund faces the neon Pudong skyline and old lanes serve xiaolongbao beside lively modern art districts.
activities: Yu Garden and Old City bazaar
Xiaolongbao at Din Tai Fung or Yang's Dumplings

shannon-ireland.description: The gateway to County Clare and the Wild Atlantic Way, with medieval castles, Cliffs of Moher views and lively pub music nearby.

sharm-el-sheikh-egypt.description: A Red Sea resort at the tip of Sinai, known for vivid coral reefs, year-round sun and desert excursions to Mount Sinai.
activities: Snorkelling and diving at Ras Mohammed National Park

skiathos-greece.description: A small Sporades island of pine-fringed coves, a lively harbour town and some of the Aegean's most sheltered sandy beaches.
activities: Day trip to Skopelos and Mamma Mia sites

sofia-bulgaria.description: Bulgaria's capital, where Roman ruins, golden-domed Orthodox churches and Soviet-era boulevards sit beneath the Vitosha mountain.

split-croatia.description: A Dalmatian port built inside a Roman emperor's palace, with a lively waterfront, nearby beaches and ferries to the Adriatic islands.

stockholm-sweden.description: A capital spread across 14 islands, with a medieval old town, the Vasa warship museum and an archipelago of summer swimming spots.

strasbourg-france.description: An Alsace city of half-timbered houses, canals and a Gothic cathedral, and home of the European Parliament, famous for its Christmas market.

stuttgart-germany.description: Baden-Württemberg's car-making capital, set in a vine-covered valley with Mercedes and Porsche museums, royal palaces and a lively wine and beer culture.
activities: Killesberg Park and Fernsehturm TV tower
Swabian Maultaschen and local Trollinger wine

tallinn-estonia.description: A walled Baltic capital with a remarkably intact medieval old town, a growing food scene and a tech-savvy, relaxed feel.
activities: Tallinn Old Town and Town Hall Square

tampa-united-states.description: A sunny Gulf Coast city of waterfront riverwalks, Cuban-influenced Ybor City and easy access to Clearwater and St Pete's white-sand beaches.

tangier-morocco.description: A whitewashed port city where Africa meets Europe, with a hilltop kasbah, Atlantic views at Cap Spartel and a long literary and café heritage.
activities: Tangier Kasbah and Dar el Makhzen
Cap Spartel and the Caves of Hercules

tashkent-uzbekistan.description: Uzbekistan's sprawling capital, mixing Soviet-era grandeur, the Chorsu Bazaar and Islamic landmarks, and a gateway to the Silk Road cities.
activities: Plov at the Central Asian Plov Centre

tel-aviv-israel.description: A Mediterranean beachfront city of Bauhaus architecture, bustling markets and a restless café, food and nightlife scene.

tenerife-spain.description: The largest Canary Island, pairing year-round sun and black-sand beaches with Mount Teide's volcanic landscapes and whale-watching waters.

thessaloniki-greece.description: Greece's second city, with Byzantine churches, a waterfront White Tower, vibrant markets and a famously good food scene.

tirana-albania.description: Albania's colourful, fast-changing capital of communist-era bunkers, Ottoman mosques, lively cafés and a mountain cable car.

tivat-montenegro.description: A Bay of Kotor gateway with a polished marina, pebble beaches and medieval Kotor and Perast within easy reach.
activities: Perast and Our Lady of the Rocks

toronto-canada.description: Canada's largest city on Lake Ontario, with the CN Tower, diverse neighbourhoods, a strong food scene and Niagara Falls within day-trip range.

toulouse-france.description: The pink-brick city of southwest France, with a vast Romanesque basilica, canal-side picnics and a deep aerospace and cassoulet culture.

troms-norway.description: An Arctic island city beneath the aurora in winter and the midnight sun in summer, ringed by fjords, peaks and Sámi culture.

tunis-tunisia.description: Tunisia's capital, with a UNESCO-listed medina, the Bardo Museum's mosaics and the blue-and-white clifftop village of Sidi Bou Said nearby.
activities: Medina of Tunis and Zitouna Mosque
Brik and couscous in the medina

turin-italy.description: Elegant Piedmontese capital of arcaded boulevards, Baroque palaces and Alpine views, home of the Egyptian Museum, vermouth and the aperitivo.
activities: Mole Antonelliana and Museo del Cinema
Shroud of Turin at the Cathedral

valencia-spain.description: A sunny Spanish coastal city of futuristic architecture, a vast urban park, city beaches and the birthplace of paella.

venice-italy.description: A lagoon city of canals, palazzi and bridges with no roads, home to St Mark's Basilica and the glass-making islands of Murano.

verona-italy.description: Shakespeare's city of star-crossed lovers, with a Roman arena that stages summer opera, Adige river bridges and Lake Garda close by.

vilnius-lithuania.description: Lithuania's baroque capital, with one of Europe's largest medieval old towns, the artists' republic of Užupis and cheap, excellent food.

warsaw-poland.description: Poland's capital, faithfully rebuilt after the war, mixing a UNESCO-listed Old Town with Soviet skyscrapers, Chopin concerts and a thriving café and bar scene.
activities: Warsaw Old Town and Royal Castle
POLIN Museum of the History of Polish Jews
Palace of Culture and Science viewing terrace

wroc-aw-poland.description: Poland's city of bridges and islands, with a colourful market square, hunt for the tiny bronze gnomes and a lively student scene.

zadar-croatia.description: A Dalmatian coastal city of Roman ruins and Venetian walls, famed for the Sea Organ, Greeting to the Sun and gateways to Kornati islands.
activities: Sea Organ and Greeting to the Sun
Roman Forum and St Donatus Church

zagreb-croatia.description: Croatia's café-filled capital, with an Austro-Hungarian upper town, quirky museums, famous Advent markets and easy trips to Plitvice.
activities: Upper Town and St Mark’s Church

zakynthos-greece.description: A Ionian island of turquoise coves, the shipwreck-framed Navagio Beach, limestone sea caves and nesting loggerhead turtles.

zurich-switzerland.description: Switzerland's financial hub on Lake Zurich, mixing a medieval old town, strong museums and quick rail links to the Alps.
